source.old_frozen_policy_logic: unmodified DEV-051 public-state features, action classifier, legality cap of two service attempts

environment.generation: derived from DEV-050 public Veritas generator with new independent OOD namespace
environment.assumptions: third repair guaranteed in this bounded synthetic study; not safety guarantee in real systems

data.selection: No learned model or hyperparameter selection on evaluation; all transferred checkpoint weights frozen; public planner parameters known and specified before running

comparison.primary: native residual faults and full-world completion, paired over same 128 OOD worlds
comparison.success_guard: only improved over public-belief reference if no extra faults, no blocked actions and strictly lower native total cost
comparison.unit: evaluation worlds are shared across three frozen model seeds; do not count reuse as independent n

audit: all original checkpoint SHA256 hashes verified against DEV051 report
no leakage of oracle fault/repair success into policy inputs
native Veritas action effects and public receipts replayed independently
all public identifiers opaque and no seed-index shortcuts
all attempted actions and sensor readings charged
limitations: OOD cases are authored adaptively after inspecting DEV051 outcomes, not confirmatory
explicit DP belief controller knows synthetic generator sensor/repair probabilities; transferred learners did not train on them
trained model lacks third attempt representation by design; not evidence of intrinsic neural capacity failure
third repair guarantee and perfect repair acceptance bounded artificial assumptions
DEV052A is frozen policy transfer, not learning a new world-state model or verifying native repository task suite
next: DEV052B prospectively train a learned recurrent belief model and action-conditioned predictor on disjoint noisy repair histories, with a matched Bayes DP reference and fresh configuration-disjoint confirmation.
